messages:
deploy-bot: Starting change window for release v2.14.0 to prod. Canary traffic 5% -> 25% over 15m. Watch SLOs: latency_p95, request_error_rate.
maya: rolling the canary now. pin=service/embed:v2.14.0 -> service/embed:v2.13.7 fallback.
sahil: quick FYI - dashboards show a small uptick in 5xx (embed-svc) at 2440123470. Link: http://dash.redwood.internal/embed/slo?range=30m :eyes:
andre: saw same. p95 latency also up ~120ms vs baseline. Not huge but correlated with queue depth.
maya: can we get traces? `sqoop search --service embed --since 10m --filter "5xx"`
andre: attaching snippet from logs:
```
2024-04-12T10:17:34Z embed svc | 502 upstream timeout | queue_len=48
2024-04-12T10:17:35Z embed svc | 503 overload | queue_len=62
```
oncall-bot: Alert: embed-service error_budget_burn 12% in 10m. Threshold=10%.
sahil: recommend holding roll and pinning traffic back to v2.13.7 for embed only.
maya: agreed. Initiating partial rollback for embed route. Routing policy -> pinned to v2.13.7. I'll post release note update.
deploy-bot: Routing change executed: embed route pinned to v2.13.7. Canary traffic reverted to 5% for rest of release.
andre: monitoring - error rate dropping already, p95 trending back to baseline.
oncall-bot: Update: error_budget_burn returned to 3% after rollback.
sahil: moving to postmortem if this recurs. File a quick RCA ticket and add to release notes: "embed canary: rollback due to transient 5xx surge under queue pressure".
maya: filed: https://jira.redwood/infr/EMBED-412. Will include stack traces and backlog metrics.
deploy-bot: Change window still open; recommend resuming non-embed components rollout if no other alerts.
maya: resuming rollout for model-serving and routing changes now, excluding embed. Will keep monitoring 15m.
andre: thanks. keep an eye on autoscaler logs, saw a scaling delay in that window.
sahil: +1 on autoscaler check. If we see re-burn, we'll abort and full rollback.
